name: eupa-stats
description: League stats and salary-cap web app built on the PRG master-sheet engine

scripts.build:share: tsc --noEmit && vite build --config vite.share.config.ts && tsx scripts/build-share.ts
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-eupa-stats "vitest run --config vitest.rules.config.ts"
scripts.e2e:online: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth --project demo-eupa-stats "playwright test -c playwright.online.config.ts"
